title: MZ Gaining traits on level up.

posts.author: Scion_of_the_Shadowlight
posts.body: I would love a plugin for this, as I do not see any natural method of doing this, such basically i want to add traits as an actor levels, such as gaining an extra attack or gaining extra % to strike or even % to attack stat.

posts.author: FleshToDust
posts.body:
You could perhaps check experience points before each fight to see if your characters are close to a level up and if after the encounter their experience is less than what it was before the encounter(they got a level up and their experience reset) then you could run a common event to determine which traits they already have so that you can decide which traits to give them. To check how much experience they have, you could perhaps find a way to set their exp to a variable and then check that variable.
Whether this is possible or not I do not know. It is worth a try though.

posts.author: kirbwarrior
posts.body:
Without Plugins, I'm not sure there's any way to do it that isn't overly complicated, especially because the main way to do it is via states and states can be removed pretty easily. Another option is to force equip an item the player can't remove when they hit a certain level, which might not look good in the equip screen if you plan on doing this a lot (although you could replace the same equipment via the common event you use to attach it in the first place).
Skills and States Core VisuStella MZ - Yanfly.moe Wiki
www.yanfly.moe
It can be done fairly easily with plugins (the above one is free, there might be better ones for your project). Then you can attach a Passive State to a skill that you learn on level up to make a "Passive Skill".

posts.author: Maliki79
posts.body:
A plugin to create an extra trait container for actors would work if paired with one that does "something" when either leveling up or learning skills.
(The learning skills one would probably be easier.)
So yeah, I'd recommend making a request in the plugin forums and see if someone is will to help you.
(It actually sounds like it could be fun, so I might do it.)
